items.statement: The submitted workflow validates the optimized 1M-TIPS ground state as a stationary minimum with a frequency or equivalent curvature test and reports the imaginary-frequency count.
items.expected: A converged geometry and explicit stationary-point validation are documented; the paper reports positive-definite Hessians.

items.statement: The Agent independently examines low-lying states and discriminates transition-character explanations using state-resolved orbital or transition-density evidence.
items.expected: The selected state is justified by energy, oscillator strength, and explicit electronic-character evidence.

items.statement: The calculated intense low-energy 1M-TIPS transition has the paper's reported vertical wavelength.
The calculated intense low-energy 1M-TIPS transition has the paper's reported oscillator strength.
The intense low-energy transition is assigned to a delocalized HOMO-to-LUMO pi-pi* excitation.
items.expected: HOMO to LUMO; highly delocalized pi orbitals; pi-pi* character.
